newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends lower on lack of keen support.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends lower on lack of keen support.

text.p: Palm oil prices finished slightly lower on lack of follow-through support after a fairly cautious trading ahead of a Buddhist religious holiday.
Traders said despite supportive crop report from forecaster, Ivan Wong and a friendly May 1-20 export data, the market was easier due to losses in the Chicago soyoil futures overnight,
"Ivan's report and the SGS's May 1-20 exports looked friendly to the market. But prices still keeping falling because of technical selling and soyoil," a trader said.
"Technically, the charts are still showing a downward signal and Aug futures will break the support 1,200 ringgit level."
At the close, the August futures contract closed 10 ringgit down at 1,210 ringgit ($483.90) a tonne.
"There was no strong buying in products. People are moving away from the market which was mainly affected by soyoil's falls," another trader said.
In his report today, Ivan Wong said Malaysia's palm oil output in May is expected to rise by three percent to 758,000 tonnes over April.
Wong projected palm oil stocks at the end of May at 725,000-730,000 tonnes, compared with the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority's (PORLA) 697,714 tonnes at end-April.
Exports in May were expected at 600,000-605,000 tonnes against 570,067 tonnes in April.
Physicals also saw scattered dealing because of lack of keen participation from buyers, traders said.

Physicals May (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,290 vs bids of 1,285 after trading from 1,290 and 1,295. May (central) saw offers at 1,277.50 vs bids 1,272.50. June (south) was offered at 1,290 vs bids at 1,282.50 after trading at 1.292.50.
June (central) saw offers at 1,290 versus bids at 1,282.50.
In refined products, May RBD palm oil was offered at $547.50, June at $542.50, July at $537.50 and July/Aug/Sept at $532.50.
June RBD palm olein saw offers at $580, July at $570, and July/Aug/Sept at $565. July was traded at $567.50.
May RBD palm stearin was offered at $410 and May palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $275.
